roles.name: coordinator
roles.purpose: Owns every open card: heals, retries, rescopes, splits or asks the owner one question; intake and contract first.
roles.artifact: the card and its verdict log

roles.name: worker
roles.purpose: Code, config, infra and web work; exactly one writer per card.

roles.name: content
roles.purpose: Posts, reports, video, pages and all social channels.

roles.name: verifier
roles.purpose: Independent verification: runs the proof itself, never trusts the writer.
roles.artifact: command output, file readback, page state
roles.proof: command output, file readback, page state

budget_note: Every worker call carries the role prompt and tool list; install.py --check measures that first call per role from the newest kanban sessions and fails above prompt_budget_tokens. A card that hits its budget stops on 'Needs you: budget exhausted'; the writer does the work, it does not re-derive the design.
